name: Access administration — approval frames
description: Contract-freeze UX artifacts for the vendor-neutral tenant/org access-administration surface (members, roles, invite/add, change-role, remove) backed by FuzeFront's Security API. Approving a flow approves its visual + interaction model AND the component/package build inventory before UI implementation. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against these via the data-frame / data-* hooks. RECONCILED to the personal-identity/root-membership model: this per-org list shows DIRECT active memberships only — access from above (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) has no membership row and is hidden here by omission; the root/portal org (members=everyone) uses the paginated member-directory feature instead; and the per-org GUEST/non-member state no longer applies to the root org, which now resolves to user_role='member' (MEMBER badge, #529 GUEST retired).
reconciles: design/frames/member-directory (root/portal 'members = everyone' uses the directory, not this small-team list)
design/frames/employee-console (inherited/derived platform-staff access is surfaced there, in a separate labelled panel — never in this direct-member list)
#529 root GUEST state — retired: root now resolves to user_role='member'

commissionedByApproval: 409 LAST_ADMIN on demote (PUT .../members/{userId}/roles) — does not exist in the contract today
409 LAST_ADMIN on remove (DELETE .../members/{userId}) — does not exist in the contract today
Contract rule: the member list is DIRECT active memberships only — inherited/derived (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) access has NO membership row and is never listed here (satisfied by omission).
The root org's user_role='member' (via the fuzefront.identity.root-membership backend slice) retires the #529 per-org GUEST state for root; the non-member state remains for ordinary un-joined orgs.

frames.label: (a) Members & roles
frames.summary: Member list for one org: person, role pill (from the tenant role catalogue), per-row change-role / remove, cursor 'Load more'.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rows render from GET /members (MemberPage, cursor). Role pills key to GET /roles (Role.key → Role.name). A member with no roles renders no pill, never a blank cell. Self-row is tagged 'You'. No vendor name in the DOM. The list is DIRECT active memberships only (data-rule='direct-only'): principals whose access comes from above (parent/root/reseller ReBAC) have no membership row and MUST NOT appear here; platform staff (Employee) are never listed. For the root/portal org, this small-team list is superseded by the member-directory feature.

frames.label: (b) Add member
frames.summary: Email + required role in a single step. Role options rendered from the tenant role catalogue.
frames.acceptanceNotes: POST /members (MemberCreate → 201 Member). Role radios come from GET /roles, never hard-coded. Fail-closed: an empty role catalogue disables submit (see frame e4) rather than adding a person with no role.

frames.label: (c) Change role
frames.summary: Ordinary role change (c1) plus the last-admin refusal (c2): the org's only admin cannot be demoted.
frames.acceptanceNotes: PUT /members/{userId}/roles (RoleAssignment → 200 Member). c2 proposes a 409 LAST_ADMIN + client pre-check that disables the demote options; the disabled control is an affordance, the server must refuse independently. A failed save re-fetches true current role (replace is non-atomic today).

frames.label: (d) Remove member
frames.summary: Confirm removal (d1) plus the last-admin refusal (d2): the org's only admin cannot be removed.
frames.acceptanceNotes: DELETE /members/{userId} (idempotent → 204). d2 proposes a 409 LAST_ADMIN + client pre-check disabling the button. 403 (no permission) is distinct — shown in place per frame e5, never a sign-in redirect.

frames.label: (e) States
frames.summary: Loading skeleton, single-member org empty state, load error+retry, empty role catalogue (add blocked), 403 forbidden shown in place, and the non-member state — with the reconciliation that root is now MEMBER (never GUEST).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Loading = aria-busy skeleton for in-flight GET /members. Empty is a real state (a fresh org has one member). Error shows data-action='retry'. e4: GET /roles returning {items:[]} disables the add form. e5: a 403 is an AUTHORIZATION denial rendered in place — NEVER a redirect to sign-in (only a 401 re-authenticates). e6: the non-member state (data-state='non-member', NOT_A_MEMBER, 403) is shown in place for an ordinary un-joined org, and carries the reconciliation (data-rule='root-is-member') that this GUEST/non-member state NO LONGER applies to the root FuzeFront org — root now resolves to user_role='member' and shows a MEMBER badge (#529 retired).
